update SYS_UPLOAD_FILE_INFO
FILE_TYPE = #{fileType,jdbcType=VARCHAR},

mapper.select: SELECT ri.REP_ID as repId, ri.REPORT_NAME as reportName FROM REP_INFO ri

select r1.SEQNO seqno, decode(r1.workflow_type,'01',r1.rep_id) startrepId, decode(r1.workflow_type,'02',r1.rep_id,r2.rep_id) offRepId, r1.workflow_type workflowType, r1.workflow_id workflowId, r1.Remark remark, r1.EFF_DATE effDate, to_char(r1.EFF_DAtE,'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mi') effDateStr, r1.REP_STATUS repStatus from REP_INFO_STATUS r1 left join REP_INFO_STATUS r2 on r1.workflow_id = r2.workflow_id and r2.workflow_type != r2.start_off where r1.workflow_type = r1.start_off
AND r1.WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SElECT COUNT(1) FROM REP_INFO_STATUS WHERE (REP_ID = #{startRepId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR REP_ID = #{offRepId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND EFF_DATE >= SYSDATE

SElECT COUNT(1) FROM REP_INFO_STATUS WHERE (REP_ID = #{startRepId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR REP_ID = #{offRepId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND REP_STATUS IN ('01','03') AND WORKFLOW_ID != #{workflowId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT REP_ID, REP_STATUS FROM( SELECT REP_ID,REP_STATUS, ROW_NUMBER()OVER(ORDER BY EFF_DATE DESC) RN FROM REP_INFO_STATUS r1 WHERE r1.REP_STATUS IN('02','04') AND (r1.Is_Synchro != 'Y' OR r1.is_synchro IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM REP_INFO_STATUS r2 WHERE r1.REP_ID = r2.REP_ID AND r2.REP_STATUS IN('02','04') AND r2.Is_Synchro ='Y' AND r1.eff_date < r2.eff_date ) AND r1.EFF_DATE <= #{sysdate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} ) WHERE RN = 1
